records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

We know getting started can slip. If you want a hand setting up your first project or inviting your team, just reply -- happy to help.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, River Collective
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for setting up River Collective on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:aeb295e5, email:614a6e9d) and no tickets filed — no signal of engagement. Starter plan, 8 days left. Silent, unstarted accounts rarely self-activate in the window.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Checking in now that River Collective's first week with Wrenfield is wrapping up. Nothing's been set up yet, and that's an easy fix — in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project in place is usually all it takes for the rest to click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you live.

Best,
Nadia
